IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_alpaca:
Not a dog: a fleece-covered pack animal.
It will not hunt and will not finish a zombie,
but it carries more than twice a dog's load,
warns you earlier than any of them,
and herds your livestock better than anything else.
It kicks a zombie down and holds it there.
Herbivore: hay, grass, vegetables, fruit - never meat.
Suffers above 24 C, at home below 4 C.
The price is a loud alarm call and a short temper in the heat.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_AlpacaFleece_desc: Your alpaca's thick fleece and calm presence are with you: unhappiness and boredom fade faster and stress eases while it stays close and comfortable. It does not show when the heat is already wearing the animal down.
IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_alpaca: Alpacas that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
IGUI_PD_BadFood_alpaca: Bad for alpacas. Eating this makes the pet sick and costs you its trust.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_alpaca:
Watches the whole sentinel range.
Hums a low warning at distant or few zombies;
gives a loud alarm call at close, numerous or visible ones,
and that call draws zombies to you (the price). Default mode.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_alpaca:
Discreet watch: covers only a short range around you
and never calls out, only hums and nudges.
It makes no noise, so it never draws zombies to you.
A cautious warning that does not give your position away.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc_alpaca:
An alpaca does not hunt.
It grazes and it guards the herd:
use Herding instead.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_alpaca: Send the alpaca to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc_alpaca: The alpaca draws attention on purpose to pull zombies toward itself. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the alpaca.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_alpaca: Hold an item and the alpaca memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_alpaca: Hold an item and the alpaca memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_alpaca: Forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_alpaca: It will no longer look for the item.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_alpaca: Click where to send the alpaca. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_alpaca: Hold the item you want the alpaca to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_alpaca: Hold the item you want the alpaca to look for.
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_alpaca: Your %1 calls out! A group of zombies!
IGUI_PD_DogLost_alpaca: %1 has gone missing! Open My Companions (paw button) > My Pets to call it back.
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_alpaca: There is no record of that alpaca to call it back.
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_alpaca: Pet despawned, try to find it to register it
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_alpaca: You fed it something alpacas shouldn't eat. Your alpaca is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_alpaca: Your alpaca is weak: it has gone too long without protein. It deals less damage and obeys less. Feed it hay, vegetables or fruit.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_alpaca: Your alpaca is hungry. Feed it before its health suffers.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_alpaca: Your alpaca is thirsty. Give it water before its health suffers.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_alpaca: You slept soundly with your alpaca bedded down nearby. For a while panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_alpaca: Your alpaca is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
